root_cause_label: ALS Low-Rank Factorization Instead of Nuclear-Norm Matrix Completion, with Verification Only on Observed Entries
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implements ALS-based matrix factorization (algorithmic mismatch with the benchmark's expected nuclear-norm minimization) and then validates only observed-entry fit, never detecting that unobserved-entry reconstruction is likely misaligned with the hidden ground truth.
t_err_evidence: Step 9: Agent creates /app/matrix_completion.py implementing ALS with rank=10, reg=0.1, iterations=50. This commits to a factorization approach that is not equivalent to the nuclear-norm/convex-relaxation method expected by the benchmark evaluation, which measures reconstruction accuracy on unobserved entries.
t_commit_evidence: Step 12: Agent runs python3 matrix_completion.py and all 20 solution files (solution_0.txt through solution_19.txt) are generated on disk using the ALS approach. The failing artifacts are now locked in; subsequent steps only read or re-generate using the same method.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumes without verification that ALS low-rank factorization will produce completions that match the benchmark's expected evaluation criterion. It acts on the implicit belief that any low-rank reconstruction with good observed-entry fit will pass the hidden ground-truth comparison, which is not the case for a nuclear-norm-minimization-based benchmark.
